posts.title: Personal Bests
posts.description: I have been tracking all my hiking and walking data since I moved to Switzerland in 2017. In the month of August of this year, I set a personal record for distance and elevation. That month alone I gained more elevation than in all of 2023 or 2024 (granted those were relatively sedentary years). For September I beat those records (by a small margin). posts.title: Happy 735th, Switzerland! 🇨🇭
posts.description: Happy Swiss National Day! I hiked up to Alp Sura for the view and then attended the local 1. August brunch in the village square with music provided by a five-member Swiss folk group. Tomorrow there's a concert followed by lunch (the finale of a 5-day summer fest) that I will also attend.
